name: Brex
one_liner: Brex spend platform with corporate cards, expenses and bill pay, plus REST API and hosted MCP.
auth_notes: Admin-generated user token (Bearer) for own account; partner OAuth2 (auth code; client credentials for onboarding) for other accounts; MCP uses OAuth with dynamic client registration.
access_notes: Own account: account or card admin accepts the developer API agreement and creates a token. Third-party multi-tenant OAuth is partner-only.

buildability.rationale: Multi-tenant OAuth requires partner status; user tokens only work for the admin's own account and need an existing Brex customer account.

needs_human_reason: Staging is documented only under partner auth; unclear whether customers get a sandbox. Verdict depends on whether multi-tenant OAuth is needed.

auth.quote: Sign in to [dashboard.brex.com](https://dashboard.brex.com/) as an [account admin or card admin]
This section is only for Brex developer partners.

access.quote: These must be accepted to use the developer API.
The [OAuth token](/guides/partner_authentication/) is used when building partner applications to authenticate other Brex accounts.

sandbox.quote: Brex currently only offers a production API server at `https://api.brex.com`.

api_surface.quote: Brex APIs offer webhooks to notify you in real-time when certain events happen in your account.

mcp.quote: The server is hosted at `https://api.brex.com/mcp` and supports any MCP-compatible client.

buildability.quote: This is different from the Brex Developer API, which requires admin-provisioned API tokens.

identity.quote: APIs to build on top of the Brex financial OS.

disputes.why: Customer auth page says only a production server; staging appears only in partner auth with no availability guarantees.
Own-account tokens are admin self-serve; only partner OAuth is gated.
Rate limits page documents 1,000 requests per 60 seconds.
